Håstad’s inapproximability of Max-Clique

      Abstract

      Håstad proved that, for every fixed ε>0\varepsilon>0ε>0, a polynomial-time n1−εn^{1-\varepsilon}n1−ε-approximation of Max-Clique would imply NP=ZPP\mathrm{NP}=\mathrm{ZPP}NP=ZPP [1]. We prove this theorem using NP from lax-434930 and ZPP from lax-666725, and its consequence under NP⊈BPP\mathrm{NP}\nsubseteq\mathrm{BPP}NP⊈BPP using the imported ZPP ⊆ BPP inclusion.

      We also state the randomized promise-gap form for Max Independent Set: for each integer q≥3q\geq3q≥3, a bounded-error polynomial-time algorithm distinguishing α(G)≤n1/q\alpha(G)\leq n^{1/q}α(G)≤n1/q from α(G)≥n1−1/q\alpha(G)\geq n^{1-1/q}α(G)≥n1−1/q on sufficiently large graphs would imply NP⊆BPP\mathrm{NP}\subseteq\mathrm{BPP}NP⊆BPP. This additional statement is an explicit unproven axiom.
